result.stdout:
FastFormat - A fast C# formatter that respects .editorconfig

Usage: dotnet-fastformat [options] [paths...]
       cat file.cs | dotnet-fastformat [options]

Options:
  -c, --check            Check formatting without making changes
  -v, --verbose          Show detailed output
  -p, --parallel N       Number of parallel workers (default: processor count)
  --include PATTERN      Include files matching glob pattern (repeatable)
  --exclude PATTERN      Exclude files matching glob pattern (repeatable)
  --stdin-filepath PATH  File path to use for .editorconfig resolution in stdin mode
  --force                Bypass project-directory safety check
  --version              Show version
  -h, --help             Show this help
